title: Comment on: “Robotic-controlled laser osteotome versus manually controlled osteotomy for interdental osteotomies: a cadaveric study” by Larsen et al. (2025)
html: We commend Larsen et al.1 for pioneering the use of a robotic cold ablation laser osteotome (CARLO) for interdental osteotomies. Their finding that CARLO achieved superior axial angulation accuracy compared with manual piezoelectric osteotomies (mean absolute error: 3.06 ± 2.13 vs 7.36 ± 4.86; P = 0.025) is noteworthy, given the difficulty of faithfully transferring a virtual surgical plan (VSP) into bone.
